style: Draw a game item icon in exactly the same art style, colouring and soft shading as <image1>: flat 2D cartoon, thick dark brown outlines, cute chunky chibi proportions, soft highlights. No character, no face, no eyes, no text, no letters. A single object, centered, filling most of the frame. No base, no ground, no shadow. Isolated on a solid flat bright pure green #00FF00 background. Do not draw the fox or the ermine from <image1>.
sheet: A 2x2 grid of four separate item icons with clear green gaps between them: top-left a short cartoon sword, top-right a round cartoon shield, bottom-left a first-aid kit, bottom-right a cartoon missile pointing down.
attack: The item is a short chunky cartoon sword: icy blue steel blade with a white shine, golden cross-guard, brown wrapped handle, pointing up and slightly tilted.
shield: The item is a round chunky cartoon shield: pale icy blue face with a white snowflake emblem in the middle, a thick silver rim with rivets.
spin: The item is a small chunky first-aid kit: white box with rounded corners, a bold red cross on the front, a short handle on top.
missile: The item is a chunky cartoon missile pointing down: white body, red rounded nose cone at the bottom, three small icy blue fins at the top, a little puff of white smoke above it.
fx_black: Absolutely no letters, no words, no text. Everything else is pure black #000000. The effect is centred and stays completely inside the picture with a wide pure black margin on every side. No characters, no creatures, no scenery.

impact.start: a small bright white and yellow four-pointed star-shaped impact flash with a few tiny sparks
impact.motion: a cartoon hit impact: the bright white-yellow star flash bursts outward into a big spiky starburst, little yellow stars and white sparks fly out in all directions, then it quickly fades away into pure black

blast.start: a small bright white-orange explosion flash core with short spikes
blast.motion: a cartoon explosion: a big round orange and yellow fireball bursts outward with a spiky shockwave ring, then turns into puffy grey smoke while orange embers fly out, then everything fades away into pure black

cloud.start: a small bright white-orange explosion flash with short spikes, sitting in the lower part of the picture
cloud.motion: a cartoon explosion: a bright orange and yellow fireball bursts up from the bottom, then a big puffy cartoon mushroom cloud rises upward from it, a round billowing orange and grey-white cloud cap on top of a thick rising smoke stem, a ring of grey smoke spreads out along the bottom, orange embers glow inside, then everything fades away into pure black

shock.start: a thin bright white and pale orange perfectly circular ring of light in the middle of the picture, seen from directly above
shock.motion: seen from directly above, a perfectly circular shockwave ring of white dust and pale orange smoke races outward from the centre toward the edges of the picture, the ring gets wider and thinner as it expands, small debris specks fly outward with it, the centre stays empty, then it fades away into pure black

ice: The item is a big chunky cartoon block of clear ice, seen slightly from above: an irregular rounded cube with bevelled facets, pale translucent icy blue, bright white shine streaks on the upper facets, a few small white cracks, a little white frost along the bottom edge. The block is mostly see-through and empty inside, nothing frozen in it.
dash: The item is a chunky cartoon lightning-bolt arrow pointing to the right: a thick zigzag bolt in icy blue and white with a bold triangular arrow head, three white speed lines trailing behind it on the left, a few small sparkles.
